---
title: "ICRC2023 Diversity Survey Results"
---

ICRC2023 ダイバーシティセッションの事前・事後アンケートの調査結果です。

The ICRC2023 Diversity session was held on July 28th, 2023 during lunchtime.
Two surveys were run around the conference:

- **[Pre-Conference Survey](pre-survey/index.qmd)** — opened July 8–21, 2023.
  Sent to all conference participants; approximately 20% responded (295 of 1406).
- **[Post-Conference Survey](post-survey/index.qmd)** — feedback collected after
  the session.

## About the data

The published figures and tables are built from an anonymized, aggregated
extract of the survey responses (`public_data.csv` and suppressed
cross-tabulations). The individual-level responses and free-text answers are
kept locally and are never committed or published. See `PLAN.md` Phase 5 for
the anonymization pipeline.

Notebooks on this site are committed with their output cells and are **not**
re-executed at render time.

## Tooling

This site is built with [Quarto](https://quarto.org/). The `titanite`
framework that produced the analysis has its
[own documentation](https://icrc2023.github.io/surveys/).
